preliminary_minutes_diagnostic.method: Preliminary lineup-only nominal minutes, each regulation period clipped to 45 minutes; sampled actual durations include stoppage; not production minutes
preliminary_minutes_diagnostic.note: Nominal clipping boundary cases are legitimate stoppage-time intervals, not malformed source data. Actual-duration samples used naive segment summation and are exploratory; overlap_checks explain one overcount. Production calculation must validate then union intervals, retain flags and exclude ambiguous appearances.
